title: F1RacePredictionInputSchema
description: Schema for pre-race feature input vector for Formula 1 Grand Prix prediction

grid_position.description: Starting grid slot on race day

driver_rolling_finish_5.description: Driver average finish position across the prior 5 races

driver_rolling_points_5.description: Driver average championship points scored across the prior 5 races

constructor_rolling_finish_10.description: Constructor team average finish position across the prior 10 entries

constructor_rolling_points_10.description: Constructor team average points across the prior 10 entries

circuit_avg_finish.description: Driver historical average finish position at this specific circuit

circuit_win_rate.description: Driver historical win rate at this specific circuit

circuit_podium_rate.description: Driver historical podium rate at this specific circuit

circuit_experience.description: Total career Grands Prix driven at this specific circuit

season_points_before.description: Driver championship points accumulated entering the round

career_starts.description: Cumulative career Grands Prix starts prior to this race

ahead_of_teammate_grid.description: 1 if driver outqualified their teammate, 0 otherwise

driver_age.description: Driver age in years at race date

grid_vs_form_gap.description: Delta between starting grid position and 5-race rolling form
